name: Downward Dog to Lunge
instructions: Lift one leg, then step the foot through to the outside of the same hand into a deep lunge.
Sink the hips, keeping the back knee off or on the floor, feeling the hip-flexor stretch.
Step back to downward dog and repeat on the other side.
cues: Stay relaxed outside the target area
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: Downward Dog to Lunge is a beginner mobility exercise for the hamstrings and quadriceps, performed with just your bodyweight. Regular mobility work keeps joints moving freely and makes strength training safer.
